decision_rationale: Primary model paper describing Longevity-LLM v0.1, a Qwen3-14B model fine-tuned on DNA methylation, proteomics, clinical biomarker, and RNA expression data. The abstract also reports proteomic profile generation and frames the work around text transformers/conversational models, supporting a text-bio generative model.
